patients.summary: Administrative assistant with long-standing bipolar disorder on lithium, migraine and Raynaud phenomenon, in the practice since 2017. Lithium brings subclinical hypothyroidism (2020-2022) and later a painless thyroiditis with nephrogenic diabetes insipidus (2025); vasospastic angina on amlodipine from 2023; a brief magnesium-supplement diarrhea in 2022.

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT VISIT

38 y/o woman transferring primary care. Works as an administrative assistant. Here to establish and for a
physical. Brought her bottles.

Bipolar disorder: diagnosed in early adulthood, on lithium for many years. Sees her psychiatrist every few
months and wants to keep that arrangement. Mood has been steady for years. Psychiatry would like levels drawn here every 6 months if we are willing, results faxed to them.
Agreed.

Migraine: has had them since her teens. Currently a couple a month.
Sumatriptan 100 mg works within an hour; rarely needs the second dose. No daily headache.

Raynaud: fingers go white then blue in the cold since her twenties. Seen by a rheumatologist about once a year.
Gloves, hand warmers, avoids the freezer aisle. No ulcers. Not on anything for it.

PMH: as above. PSH: tonsillectomy as a child.
Meds: lithium carbonate 300 mg BID (psychiatry); sumatriptan 100 mg PRN, max 200 mg/day.
Allergies: NKDA.
FHx: mother with bipolar disorder. Sister with migraines. Maternal grandmother hypothyroid.
SHx: never smoker, no alcohol, no drugs. Lives in Holyoke. Office job.

ROS: no chest pain, dyspnea, palpitations. No rash. No joint swelling. Periods regular.

Exam: well-appearing, pleasant, good eye contact. HEENT normal, tonsils surgically absent. Thyroid not enlarged,
no nodules. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft. Hands warm today, normal color, no digital
ulcers or pitting, capillary refill brisk. No tremor. Neuro nonfocal. Skin clear.

PHQ-9: 3.

A/P
1. Bipolar disorder, stable on lithium. Lithium level, CMP, TSH today; repeat every 6 months and copy to
   psychiatry.
2. Migraine, episodic. Continue sumatriptan; will take over refills.
3. Raynaud phenomenon. Continue cold measures, rheum follows.
4. Health maintenance: CBC, lipids, HIV and hep C screen today. Last Pap 2016 at prior office per pt; records
   requested. Mammogram discussion at 40.

documents.title: After visit summary
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Welcome to the practice.
- Labs drawn today; results by portal in 1-2 days.
- Lithium level, kidney and thyroid tests every 6 months here (June and December); we send results to your
  psychiatrist.
- Sumatriptan: refills through us from now on.
- Keep your rheumatology follow-up.
- Call or text any time; same-day visits available.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Hi Erin, it was nice meeting you yesterday. Everything came back fine: lithium level is in the target range,
kidney function, thyroid, blood counts and cholesterol are all normal, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens are
negative. I faxed a copy to your psychiatrist's office. Next lithium check in December.

reports.text: Outside result in prior practice records. Specimen satisfactory for evaluation; transformation zone present.
reports.conclusion: Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. High-risk HPV not detected.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam.

Doing well. Mood good, sees psychiatry in the fall. Lithium unchanged, 300 BID. Migraines 2-4/month, the PA for
the extra sumatriptan went through and that has helped. Raynaud quiet in summer. Work busy, sleeping ok.

Meds: lithium 300 mg BID, sumatriptan 100 mg PRN. NKDA.

ROS: no chest pain, SOB, GI or GU complaints raised. No breast lumps.

Exam: NAD. Thyroid normal size, nontender. RRR, lungs clear. Breasts without masses, no adenopathy.
Abdomen benign. Extremities warm, no edema, no digital changes. No tremor.

PHQ-9 2.

Plan
- Bipolar d/o: lithium level, CMP, TSH today, copy to psychiatry.
- Migraine: stable; refilled sumatriptan.
- Raynaud: no change.
- Turning 40 next month: screening mammogram ordered, she'll schedule for August. Pap due 2021. Flu shot in
  the fall.

documents.title: Labs from your physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
All of your labs are normal, including the lithium level and thyroid. Copy sent to your psychiatrist.
Don't forget to book the mammogram.

documents.title: Psychiatry progress letter
documents.author: psychiatry
documents.body:
OUTPATIENT PSYCHIATRY — PROGRESS LETTER TO PRIMARY CARE
Date of visit: 11/19/2018

Dear colleague,

Ms. Brooks continues in our care for bipolar disorder. She remains euthymic on lithium carbonate 300 mg twice
daily, with no manic or depressive symptoms since we last wrote, good sleep and steady function at work. No
side effects she finds troublesome. We reviewed your June labs; level and renal and thyroid indices are
acceptable.

Plan: continue lithium at current dose. We would be grateful if you could continue the six-monthly lithium
level, renal panel and TSH. Return visit with us in about 3 months.

Allergies: none known.

Outpatient psychiatry

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Follow-up. Migraines have been about 3 a month this winter, same pattern, sumatriptan still works. Uses
about 8-10 tabs a month at most. Sumatriptan PA expires next month, wants it renewed. Raynaud more frequent with
the cold, mostly getting into the car in the morning; color returns in 10-15 minutes once she warms up. No sores
on fingertips. Mood fine.

O: Vitals reviewed. Hands cool, pink, no ulcers or pitting scars, radial pulses 2+. Neuro grossly normal.

A/P:
- Migraine, episodic, stable. Renew sumatriptan, MA to handle PA renewal. Reviewed headache red flags.
- Raynaud, seasonal flare. Layering, gloves, warm the car first. She sees rheumatology in the spring.

documents.body:
ANNUAL PHYSICAL — 40F

Interval: no new issues. Psych visits every 3 months, stable on lithium. Migraines 2-3/month. Raynaud quieted
down with spring. Saw rheumatology in April, nothing changed.

Meds reviewed: lithium carbonate 300 mg BID, sumatriptan 100 mg PRN.
Allergies: NKDA.
Social: never smoker, no alcohol. Same job.

Exam: BP and vitals per flowsheet. Thyroid normal. Heart and lungs normal. Breast exam normal. Abdomen soft.
No edema. Skin normal. Normal affect.

PHQ-9 3.

Plan:
1. Lithium labs today with CBC and CMP; copy to psychiatry.
2. Mammogram: annual vs every other year discussed; she'll do every other year. Next 2020.
3. Pap due 2021.
4. Flu shot this fall.
